name: Magomed Ankalaev

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (75 in height, 75 in reach); 205.5 lb at the UFC Abu Dhabi weigh-in (Jul 2026)

photo_coverage: Adequate. Current (Jul 2026) studio headshot and cutout, a Mar 2025 cutout, two Oct 2025 weigh-in shots, a Mar 2025 left profile (face-off), a Jul 2026 action three-quarter view and a large frontal celebration photo. Only one freely licensed photo exists on Commons (2018, CC BY 3.0; a second file of the same 2018 session could not be downloaded because of rate limiting). His fringe hides the forehead in every recent photo; the 2018 photo is the only view of his hairline and ears.

face.shape: Long, medium-narrow oval face: clearly taller than wide, with a long midface (long nose) and high cheekbones. Lean, with slight hollows under the cheekbones.
face.jaw: Hidden by the full beard in all 2025-2026 photos. In the 2018 photo (shorter beard) the jaw is of medium width with a long, gently tapering line.
face.chin: Under the beard; the beard outline suggests a medium-width, fairly long chin. The beard hangs 5-7 cm below it.
face.cheekbones: High and prominent, a visible ridge under the eyes. Flat to slightly hollow cheeks below, where the beard line starts.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate. The brows sit low and close above the eyes.
face.forehead: High and broad in the 2018 photo (short hair). In 2025-2026 it is covered almost to the brows by a heavy fringe.

eyes.shape: Almond, medium size, slightly deep-set, with fine lines under the eyes

eyebrows.shape: Low and fairly straight, angled slightly down toward the nose (inner ends lowest), which gives a stern look

nose.width: narrow to medium at the bridge, medium at the base
nose.bridge: High and straight; slightly convex in profile (UFC 313 face-off, Abu Dhabi action)
nose.tip: Fleshy, rounded and slightly downturned, with a long columella
nose.fight_damage: Possibly slightly off-centre at the lower bridge in the 2018 photo; no obvious break

face.mouth_lips: Medium-narrow. Thin upper lip, medium lower lip; often pressed together or pursed (weigh-in faces). Corners slightly down.

ears.cauliflower_ear: No: smooth, normally folded ears in the 2018 close-up.
ears.note: They lie fairly close to the head; in 2025-2026 the hair covers their tops.

face.notable_marks_scars: Several small moles on the front of the neck and upper chest; the largest is a dark red-brown mole on the right side of the neck, just below the beard line (ESPN headshot). Light freckling across the nose and cheeks in studio light.

hair.style: 2025-2026: thick hair grown out on top and brushed forward into a heavy, straight fringe that reaches just above the brows; the sides cover the tops of the ears; a rounded, bowl-like outline. In 2018 it was a short crop.
hair.length_note: About 8-10 cm on top, 4-6 cm at the sides.
hair.colour_note: Very dark brown, near black. Raw ESPN sample #261a16; arena light #252229.
hair.hairline: Straight front hairline (2018), now hidden by the fringe
hair.texture: Straight to slightly wavy, thick and dense

facial_hair.detail: Dense full beard covering the jaw, the cheeks below the cheekbones and the chin; about 5-7 cm long under the chin, trimmed to a rounded-square bottom. The moustache is trimmed short above the lip and blends into the beard. Natural, high cheek line.
facial_hair.colour_note: Clearly reddish (auburn/ginger-brown) and much warmer than his near-black hair. Raw ESPN chin sample #452110, lit strands #653925, side of the beard #613e2c. It looks darker under arena light (AFP chin #200f0e).
facial_hair.shape: full, rounded-square, longer at the chin than at the sides

skin.tone_hex_method: plain RGB mean of the samples marked in_average (well-lit, near-neutral cheek and forehead-free patches); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma percentile pixels of the patch

tone_samples.where: forehead between brows, below the fringe

skin.undertone: Neutral-to-warm with pink; flushes red after exertion (AFP photo).
skin.freckles_marks: Light freckles across the nose and cheeks; small moles on the neck and upper chest. Visible dark hair on the chest (down the sternum), abdomen, forearms and legs.
skin.note: Fair-to-light skin. The ESPN and Getty weigh-in cheeks agree well (#ee9a85 to #fdc4a8). The 2018 Commons still has a yellow cast and is left out of the average.

body.build: Tall, long-limbed light heavyweight (190.5 cm, 93 kg at the Jul 2026 weigh-in): lean and rangy rather than bulky.
body.body_fat_note: Upper abs and serratus show; the lower abdomen is slightly soft. Not stage-lean.
body.shoulders: Broad but slightly sloping; rounded delts; long collarbones
body.chest: Moderate, flat pectorals with dark hair down the sternum
body.arms: Long arms (reach 190.5 cm), lean and sinewy, with visible veins and a biceps peak when flexed
body.legs_calves: Long, slim legs with lean thighs and slim calves; hairy
body.posture: Upright, head slightly forward, chin down, relaxed shoulders
body.notable: Long neck and long torso. Body hair is a visible part of the look.

tattoos_note: None visible in any photo (front, both sides; the back is only partly seen in the action shot).

kit.fight_shorts: Red Venum UFC shorts with dark-red tiger-stripe print and white slashes, black waistband and crypto.com logo (2025 and Jul 2026 ESPN cutouts); red shorts with a white checkered waistband panel at UFC Abu Dhabi (Jul 2026).

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets from the full MakeHuman set. They are not in the shipped assets/embed/mh-manifest.json, so they are listed here and not under morphs. His ears are close to the base mesh, so none are suggested.

morphs_unavailable: No target for the fringe, the long reddish beard or body hair: these come from hair/beard proxies and the skin texture. No ear targets in the shipped manifest (not needed for him).
notes: Confidence: high for the overall look (long face, long straight nose, high cheekbones, heavy straight fringe, dense auburn full beard that is redder than the hair, light-brown eyes, fair skin, tall lean hairy build, no tattoos); medium for exact morph values; low for the jaw and chin shape, which are hidden by the beard in every recent photo. Watch for: (1) beard colour must be visibly warmer/redder than the near-black hair; one dark colour for both loses the likeness; (2) the fringe covers the forehead to the brows in 2025-2026; do not render a bare forehead or short crop (that is the 2018 look); (3) keep him slim and long-limbed, not a bodybuilder; (4) macro/heightUpM uses heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 from research/assets.md; measure the built mesh and nudge until it reads 190.5 cm.
